mapper.select: SELECT p.p_code, p.p_name, p.p_color, p.p_size, p.p_price, p.p_image, p.p_rating, p.p_url, p.subcategory_id AS subcategoryId, s.category_id AS categoryId FROM products p JOIN subcategories s ON p.subcategory_id = s.subcategory_id WHERE s.category_id = #{categoryId}
SELECT p_code, p_name, p_color, p_size, p_price, p_image, p_rating, p_url, subcategory_id AS subcategoryId FROM products WHERE subcategory_id = #{subcategoryId}

SELECT p.p_code, p.p_name, p.p_color, p.p_size, p.p_price, p.p_image, p.p_rating, p.p_url, p.subcategory_id AS subcategoryId, s.name AS subcategoryName, c.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName FROM products p LEFT JOIN subcategories s ON p.subcategory_id = s.subcategory_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON s.category_id = c.category_id

SELECT p.p_code, p.p_name, p.p_color, p.p_size, p.p_price, p.p_image, p.p_rating, p.p_url, p.subcategory_id AS subcategoryId, s.name AS subcategoryName, c.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName FROM products p LEFT JOIN subcategories s ON p.subcategory_id = s.subcategory_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON s.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.p_code = #{p_code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (p_code, p_name, p_color, p_size, p_price, p_image, p_rating, p_url, subcategory_id) VALUES (seq_products.nextval+1000, #{p_name}, #{p_color}, #{p_size}, #{p_price}, #{p_image}, #{p_rating}, #{p_url}, #{subcategoryId})
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET p_name = #{p_name}, p_color = #{p_color}, p_size = #{p_size}, p_price = #{p_price}, p_image = #{p_image}, p_rating = #{p_rating}, p_url = #{p_url}, subcategory_id = #{subcategoryId} WHERE p_code = #{p_code}
mapper.select: SELECT p.p_code, p.p_name, p.p_color, p.p_size, p.p_price, p.p_image, p.p_rating, p.p_url, p.subcategory_id AS subcategoryId, s.name AS subcategoryName, c.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName FROM products p LEFT JOIN subcategories s ON p.subcategory_id = s.subcategory_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON s.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY p.p_code DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
